text.text_excerpt: Dinga dong ding! Only 1 review for Root? Well, allow me to add the second! I ate here last night with a friend of mine for one of my birthday dinners. It was my first time, and it was amazing. I had the gulf fish and my friend had the scallops. My fish was amazing and I sampled the scallops, and they were great too! They came in a cigar box because they are "smoked". How cute is that?? Also, for the appetizer, we got the Aloo Gabi which is basically grilled cauliflower and potatoes in a yummy sauce. It was a little spicy, but I loved it. For dessert we had the "Yorkie" which is a frozen york peppermint pattie served with mint ice ceream, coco puffs (yes, the cereal) and milk. It was like ...

My partner and I were anxiously excited to try this place because we love creative and eclectic food, and Root did not disappoint. On a weeknight we visited they were not crowded. Upon arrival I immediately liked their clean, modern atmosphere and welcoming feel. Each of us enjoyed a cocktail at the bar before seated at the table. Mine was light and refreshing, just perfect start to an enjoyable dinner. By the way, if you enjoy unique craft cocktails, their drink menu is a fun one to study. A friend joined at the table and we ordered 9 different things to sample from small plates to dessert, which all turned out to be visually appealing and delicious. Service was good. Our server was rela...

Root is my new favorite dining experience in NOLA. The food is an excellent adventure and the service is exceptional with out being snooty! Root wants you noshing in their restaurant and you know it. I will say--you must try the oysters, lobster lasagna, CBD, face bacon, scallops, and beet salad. The yorkie dessert is so fantastic and I love eating "cereal" in a restaurant setting. It makes me feel child like. Sadly, I was not as impressed with the steak and marrow bones as I was with everything else we have tried.
